meta.name: smart-explore
meta.description: Token-optimized structural code search using tree-sitter AST parsing. Use instead of reading full files when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase efficiently.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AST解析快速搜索代码结构，替代逐文件阅读
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在不熟悉的代码库中快速找到函数或结构
copy.tagline_en: Search code structure quickly with AST parsing, replacing full file reads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find functions or structures in unfamiliar codebases

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 探索代码时改用 smart_search、smart_outline、smart_unfold 三个工具,不再直接整份读文件:先给出符号、签名、行号的代码地图,再按需展开某个函数或类的源码。
howto.when: 当你要理解代码结构、查找函数或探索代码库时触发。技能激活期间它会接管默认探索行为,替代 Read、Grep、Glob。

say.text: 用 smart_search 在 ./src 里搜 shutdown
say.note: 返回排序后的符号和文件结构
得到该文件的函数与类骨架

say.text: 展开该文件里的 shutdown 方法源码
say.note: 只返回这个符号的完整实现

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude explores code with smart_search, smart_outline and smart_unfold instead of reading whole files: you get a map of symbols, signatures and line numbers first, then the source of one symbol on demand.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase; while active it takes over default exploration, replacing Read, Grep and Glob.

say_en.text: Use smart_search to find shutdown in ./src
say_en.note: Returns ranked symbols and file structure

say_en.text: Unfold the shutdown method in that file
